en.state_hint_empty: Add at least one reading to calculate a descriptive summary.
en.state_hint_partial: Enter a date and values, then add the reading.
en.state_hint_full: Descriptive statistics calculated from the readings you entered.
en.state_hint_invalid: A value is outside the accepted range; fix it before adding.
en.state_hint_degraded: The calculation could not produce a valid result. Your inputs are unchanged; try again.
en.scope_note: This page records measurements you enter and calculates descriptive minimum, maximum, and arithmetic mean values. It does not predict side effects, apply alert thresholds, assess urgency, diagnose, or recommend treatment.
en.assessment_unavailable: Clinical assessment: NOT_AVAILABLE. Summary values describe only the entries in this session.
en.validation_error: Enter a real date and finite positive readings within the allowed input bounds.
en.summary_limit: These statistics are arithmetic summaries only. They do not identify a trend, cause, diagnosis, risk level, or need for treatment.
en.not_a_prescription: This page is not a diagnosis and not a prescription.
en.formula_body: The engine computes descriptive arithmetic statistics only (count, minimum, maximum, arithmetic mean) for the readings you entered. No clinical thresholds or inference are applied.
en.assumptions_body: Readings reflect what you entered; they are not independently verified and no clinical interpretation is applied.
en.referral_not_available: Referral wording is not available without specialist approval.

en.evidence_pending_review: A public reference cannot be shown until a specialist approves the exact source.
en.box10_note: The file is created inside the browser only; it carries no session identifier.
en.box10_unavailable: Add at least one reading to enable the export.
en.box11_na: NOT_AVAILABLE — history requires the W18 storage decision. Nothing is saved or shown here.
en.not_a_diagnosis: Do not use these summaries to diagnose, assess urgency, or decide treatment.
en.c5_not_available: NOT_AVAILABLE — this wording requires specialist approval.
